## [0.35.1] - 2026-09-22

A patch release: a resize flash on the script editor, a cut-off suggestion
list, and a value like `{{$randomInt}}` changing on screen without you
touching anything.

### Changed

- The Bulk edit / Table toggle above Params and Headers is now a smaller
  segmented control, matching the compact controls used elsewhere in the app.

### Fixed

- **A dynamic value could change on screen with nothing edited.**
  `{{$randomInt}}`, `{{$guid}}` and the like generate a fresh value each time
  they're read, and three places re-read them on almost every redraw instead
  of once: the Params tab's resolved-URL preview, a GraphQL request's schema
  lookup, and an unnamed tab's own title. All three now hold the value they
  first showed until something about the request actually changes.
- Dragging the script editor's height no longer flashes back to the old
  height right after you let go. The same drag, and the drawer/context-bar
  width drag, now also take Page Up/Down, Home, End and a reset key, and
  releasing the pointer outside the window no longer leaves the drag stuck.
- The Headers tab's key suggestion list was cut off after 10 entries with no
  way to reach the rest of the 31 standard headers; it now scrolls to every
  entry.
- Switching Params or Headers into Bulk edit hid the "Added by Vayu" default
  headers and the resolved-URL preview; both now stay visible, and a Discard
  button lets you leave Bulk edit without applying a half-finished draft.
- The "Open Demo API" tile now also appears on a brand-new, empty workspace's
  welcome screen, not only after you've already created a collection or
  request.
- The workspace-backup restore instructions now say the copied file also
  needs renaming to match the live database - following them literally used
  to leave two files side by side instead of replacing anything.
